title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the Data API refuses a malformed or negative page window with a 400 naming the parameter as written
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRKKHew7xesRk21mGXrtFzY)_

Fixes #25229

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

`findData`'s list-query normalizer (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) coerced the page window with a bare `Number(...)`. It now goes through `pageWindowValue`, which accepts only a non-negative safe integer and otherwise throws `400 INVALID_REQUEST` naming the parameter the caller wrote (`$top`, `top`, `limit`, `$skip`, `skip`, `offset`), before any read.

That statement is the one place every list door meets with the window still unvalidated: `GET /data/:object` hands its querystring straight in, `POST /data/:object/query` validates its body against `FindDataRequestSchema` (which checks the type, not the sign) and then hands the same body in, and the runtime dispatcher's data list forwards its query the same way. So there is one check and no second validator on one door. The spec query schema is not touched: the shared normalizer sees every spelling, so the narrowing the order allowed in `packages/spec` was not needed.

One REST door file changes, and it is not a second validator. `GET /data/:object/export` (`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`) feeds its own `findData` loop a chunk read from `?page=`, clamped to 50..5000 but not floored, so `?page=100.5` became a `limit` of 100.5. The new check would refuse that with a 400 naming `limit`, a parameter the export caller never wrote, where the base streamed the export. The chunk is now `Math.trunc`ed where `page` is read. That keeps the door's ledgered exemption (no `page` value turns a correct export into a 400).

## Measured (base `345f0b154c`, stock showcase boot, `showcase_account`, 14 rows, admin session)

| request | base | this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET ?$skip=-5` | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`, names `$skip` |
| `GET ?$skip=-1&$top=3` | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 400, names `$skip` |
| `POST {"offset":-5}` | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 400, names `offset` |
| `GET ?$top=abc` | 200, 14 rows | 400, names `$top` |
| `GET ?$top=-1` | 200, 14 rows | 400, names `$top` |
| `POST {"limit":-1}` | 200, 14 rows | 400, names `limit` |
| `GET ?$top=` | 200, 0 rows | 400, names `$top` |
| `POST {"limit":"ten"}` | 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` `query.limit` | unchanged |
| `GET ?$skip=abc` | 200, 14 rows | 400, names `$skip` |
| `POST {"offset":1.5}` | 200, 13 rows | 400, names `offset` |
| `POST {"limit":1.5}` | 200, 1 row | 400, names `limit` |
| `POST {"limit":0}` | 200, 0 rows | unchanged |
| `GET ?$skip=` | 200, 14 rows | 400, names `$skip` |
| `GET ?$top=5&$skip=2` | 200, 5 rows | unchanged |
| `POST {"limit":5,"offset":2}` | 200, 5 rows | unchanged |

The base 500s log `A non-negative integer must be provided to offset.` from knex `QueryBuilder.offset` (driver-sql). Every row of the card's table reproduced on today's `main`.

## The blank value: refused, not read as absent

`?$top=` and `?$skip=` answer 400. The blank `?filter=` is read as absent because an empty filter and no filter mean the same thing. An empty window does not: an absent window means every row, so reading `?$top=` as absent would be the silent widening this card closes, and reading it as `0` (the base) answers an empty page nobody asked for. `?$skip=` used to answer the right rows by coincidence (`Number('')` is `0`, the same as no offset); it is refused too, so one rule covers both slots. `0` stays valid on both (`$top=0` asks for the total alone).

## Error code

`INVALID_REQUEST`, status 400, `param` set to the caller's spelling: the same code and shape the same normalizer already answers for a repeated window parameter (`?$top=1&$top=2`). No new code, so the error-code ledger does not move.

## Clause-② and Metadata-protocol

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. Nothing is widened and no public surface grows. A request the doors used to answer (200 with every row, 200 with a rounded window, or 500) is now refused, so a published accept set narrows: the changeset carries the BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition (`not-required`, no migration).
- `Metadata-protocol: none`. A query window is a request parameter, not metadata an author writes, so the changeset is `patch`.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.page-window.test.ts` (new). Refusal: 17 spellings and values, each asserting `code`, `status`, `param` and the message's first clause, with the engine never called. Plus the bounded quote of the refused value. Preservation: 7 well-formed windows reach `engine.find` as the same integers, `0` included.
- `packages/rest/src/data-page-window-door.test.ts` (new, the door-level conformance test). Both routes over a real `SqlDriver` (SQLite): 11 querystring refusals and 4 body refusals answer 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` naming the spelling, with zero reads of the object. `{"limit":"ten"}` is still the schema's `VALIDATION_FAILED`. Controls page as before on both doors (`$top=2&$skip=1`, `limit: 2, offset: 1`, `top`/`skip`, no window, `limit: 0`, `$skip=0`).
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run mode, then `metadata-protocol` rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight` showed the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`). The check was replaced by the base's bare `Number(value)`: the unit file went 18 failed / 7 passed (every refusal red, every preservation green), the door file 2 failed / 2 passed (both refusal tests red, both control tests green). Restore: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` over all 22 built files, both files green again (25/25, 4/4).
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts` (the export `page` exemption's pin, extended). `'100.5'` joins the loop asserting that every `page` value streams the same rows. A new test asserts that every `limit` the stub `findData` receives is a non-negative safe integer, over `abc`, empty, `1.5`, `100.5`, `Infinity`, `-5`, `50` and `5000`. Ablation with the `Math.trunc` removed: 2 failed / 14 passed (the new pin, and the stream loop at `100.5`). Restored, blob equal to HEAD: 16/16.
- Local, after a full build of the `@objectstack/rest^...` closure (head `8845dd244`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` exit 0, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` exit 0, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` 257 files passed, 3 skipped, 20893 tests passed, 19 skipped; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test` 316 files, 6326 passed, 326 skipped.

## Gates (local, head `90e4e4d69e`)

- On head `90e4e4d69e`, the current head with the export chunk fix: `--commands` derived 69 families, the 68 below plus `check:route-envelope`. All 69 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciled them: 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` exit 0. The full rest suite and dogfood were not re-run for this one-line delta; CI's `Test Core` covers it.
- On the first head `8845dd244`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on that diff derived 68 families. All 68 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciled them: 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Six needed a second run, each for a local reason outside the diff, and each exited 0 on the rerun. `check:issue-citations`: the board read failed once. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: the shallow clone lacked its pinned fixture commit, which was then fetched. `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: they ran during a concurrent rebuild of declaration files. `check:query-options-erasure` and `check:type-check-debt`: they hit a 300 s local timeout on a shared box.
- Full dogfood, required by the `(narrowing)` arm, run on head `8845dd244` exactly as CI runs it (the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure built, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock): VERDICT command-exit 0, 287 files passed and 3 skipped (290), 2398 tests passed and 18 skipped (2416).
- `origin/main` is 9 commits ahead of the base. None of them touches `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/rest` or the runtime data domain, and a local `merge-tree` is clean, so the branch was not re-merged. CI runs on the merge ref.

## Acceptance notes

- The message's second sentence ("a window the driver cannot read is either dropped, answering every row, or rejected by the database") describes the negative and NaN cases. A fractional window was rounded by the driver rather than dropped, which the sentence does not name. It is refused for the same reason (a window the caller did not mean), and the PR does not pin the sentence.
- `driver-sql`'s knex call is untouched, as the claim says: the window never reaches it malformed once refused upstream. A direct `engine.find` caller that passes `offset: -1` without going through `findData` still meets knex's throw. That is a different door (in-process, not the Data API) and is not in this card.
